title: India Lands 2029 Champions Trophy and 2031 World Cup in ICC Calendar to 2035
excerpt: The ICC Board, meeting in Bali, fixed windows for its major men's events through 2035: India hosts the Champions Trophy in October 2029 and shares the 2031 World Cup with Bangladesh.
body:
• India will host the ICC Men's Champions Trophy from 9 to 28 October 2029, the ICC confirmed on Sunday.
  • India and Bangladesh will co-host the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup from 9 October to 23 November 2031.
  • England will stage the World Test Championship finals in 2029 and 2031; hosts for the 2032 to 2035 events are yet to be confirmed.
  • For fans planning ahead: the next World Cup on Indian soil is 2031. Venues, fixtures and ticket details have not been announced.

India will host the 2029 ICC Men's Champions Trophy and co-host the 2031 Cricket World Cup with Bangladesh, after the ICC Board approved the windows for its major men's events through 2035 at its meetings in Bali, Indonesia. The confirmed schedule runs from the Men's T20 World Cup in Australia and New Zealand in 2028 to the Cricket World Cup of 2035, whose hosts are still to be decided, according to the ICC's announcement.

India's two tournaments

The Champions Trophy will be played in India from 9 to 28 October 2029. India are the tournament's current holders, so the 2029 edition is a home defence of the title. The 50-over World Cup then returns to the subcontinent in 2031, co-hosted by India and Bangladesh from 9 October to 23 November - eight years after India last staged it in 2023. The 2027 edition, the next one to be played, is in southern Africa, hosted by South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia.

T20 World Cups and Test finals

The T20 World Cup stays on its two-year cycle: Australia and New Zealand host in 2028, and England co-hosts the 2030 edition with Scotland and Ireland from 4 July to 4 August. The venues for 2032 and 2034 are yet to be decided. The World Test Championship final remains a biennial fixture in June, with England confirmed as hosts for 2029 and 2031 and the 2033 and 2035 hosts to be confirmed. The Board also approved qualification formats for upcoming tournaments, including the 2027 Men's ODI World Cup Qualifier, to be played in February-March 2027 with 10 teams competing in 23 matches, according to the ICC's media release reported by ANI.

"We also recognise the importance of providing athletes and member associations long-term visibility of these events to enable development of improved player pathways, focused high-performance programmes and structured calendars."

- Sanjog Gupta, ICC Chief Executive

What it means, and what comes next

As things stand, Australia hold the Men's Cricket World Cup, South Africa hold the World Test Championship mace, and India hold both the Men's T20 World Cup and the Men's Champions Trophy. The long-range calendar gives boards, players and fans fixed windows years in advance, but the detail that decides a trip - host cities, venues, fixtures and ticket sales for 2029 and 2031 - is still to come from the ICC and the host boards. The immediate focus is next year's World Cup in southern Africa; India's home dates are now on the calendar behind it.
